change: Only author file-writing/duplicate-delivery obligation and corresponding output-path instruction differ. Full C35 common rules, Covenant and persona unchanged.
loop: One fresh whole-story Terra/max author task per output. Both read the same frozen context. Save condition writes a separate artifact and returns fiction; return condition emits final fiction only. Root captures the exact first public final in both conditions without alteration. No editor or selector.
primary_review_surface: Captured public final answer in both conditions. Control author-written file is retained and compared separately; never choose the better surface.
scope: Two contexts by two conditions by two fresh repeats: eight first outputs, zero fresh long sessions. Opening has no prior story prose; dinner includes exact published C35 B00-B02 and B03 input, including original formatting.
screening_rule: Advance for further trials only if both reviewers find substantive return-only advantage in both contexts, both return repeats per context score at least4 for prose, and there is no material loss or unresolved boundary failure. This does not select a candidate or replace the two substantial-session and held-out-probe requirements.
limits: Tests combined task/delivery obligation and within-task effects, not accumulated repeated prose in a persistent conversation. No direct story API call or production latency/cache/cost claim. Technical noncompliance and unfavorable first outputs remain recorded; no rerolls.
